answer: Anchor each agent identity to one registered land parcel with priced stock - a knoll carrying 400 m3 of timber - so an identity exists only behind collateral someone pays annual rent on. Liveness checks demand a fresh anemometer reading (a zephyr above 2 m/s) signed at that parcel and matching public weather records; one device serves exactly one key. A sybil must rent extra parcels at full price per identity, no bulk discount, while an honest user pays once; when rent lapses the plot is released, so cloning cost scales linearly with n.
